caption: Layer grouping patterns, where the horizontal and vertical axes represent groups (G_1, , G_4) and numbers of layers in groups.
model_annotation: This chart illustrates five distinct layer grouping patterns, with the horizontal axis representing the group labels and the vertical axis representing the number of layers in each group. The value axis is unlabeled but appears to have a linear scale, with tick marks indicating the layer counts. Each pattern, labeled as Increasing, Uniform, Decreasing, Spindle, and Bottleneck, is represented by a set of bars. The Increasing pattern shows bars of approximate heights 1, 2, and 4 layers, with the tallest bar on the right. The Uniform pattern displays bars of equal height, approximately 2 layers. The Decreasing pattern has bars of approximate heights 4, 2, and 1 layer, with the tallest bar on the left. The Spindle pattern features bars of approximate heights 1, 3, and 1 layer. The Bottleneck pattern shows bars of approximate heights 1, 1, and 2 layers. The bars within each pattern are visually arranged in a sequence from left to right, with no specific sorting or emphasis applied.
